input:
We're seeing random SIGILL crashes on our ARMv9 big.LITTLE platform when tasks migrate from Cortex-A720 (big) to Cortex-A520 (LITTLE) cores. The big cores have SVE2 VL=256 but LITTLE cores report VL=128. EAS keeps migrating compute-heavy tasks to LITTLE during thermal throttling. Here's the relevant dmesg:

[  42.301] CPU4 (A720): sve: vector length 256 bits
[  42.305] CPU0 (A520): sve: vector length 128 bits
[  84.112] Internal error: Oops - Loss of SVE state: 0000000e [#1] PREEMPT SMP
[  84.112] CPU: 0 PID: 3421 Comm: render_thread Tainted: G        W
[  84.113] pc : 0x7f8a003c40 (libSVE_kernels.so+0x3c40)
[  84.114] Code: SVE2 instruction with VL=256 assumption
[  84.201] thermal_zone0: temperature=85000, throttling active
[  84.203] sugov: CPU4-7 freq capped to 1200MHz

How do we fix this without disabling SVE2 entirely? The workload needs vector operations.
